channel.title: Omniverse Compute (OMC) — News & Announcements
channel.description: Official Omniverse Compute (OMC) updates: testnet milestones, airdrop campaigns, engineering progress and governance announcements.

item.title: 800V is retiring the 54V busbar data centers used for a decade
item.description: New on forum.omc.network: the rack-power math now shaping AI data-center build cost. Why 800V direct current is replacing the legacy 54V busbar in high-density racks, how busway losses scale with per-GPU wattage, and why the last meter of power delivery has become a compute bottleneck, not just an electrical one. Read →

item.title: A gigawatt AI site needs an army of electricians, not just chips
item.description: New on forum.omc.network: the labor queue behind AI compute. One gigawatt of data-center capacity draws a large skilled-trades workforce — electricians, pipefitters, cooling specialists — while transformer and switchgear lead times now rival the GPU wait. Read →

item.title: The interconnect tax: why 800G ports — not GPUs — cap how big a cluster can get
item.description: New on forum.omc.network: a deep dive on the network fabric, the bill everyone prices last. 800G ports, the radix math behind spine-leaf topology, and why one oversubscribed uplink can stall an entire training run. Read →

item.title: The OMC airdrop is open: 20,000,000 OMC, 1,000,000 slots, free to join
item.description: Registration is live. 20,000,000 OMC is split into 1,000,000 slots of 20 OMC each, first come first served. No purchase and no presale — three social tasks plus a wallet signature. Claiming opens 1 January 2027 with a 0.01 BNB processing fee per entry. Read the announcement →

item.title: The one dial that decides if a 70B model fits your GPU: quantization, explained
item.description: New on top.omc.network: a plain-English glossary entry on quantization, the one formula (VRAM ≈ params × bytes/weight) every local-LLM buyer needs, and why Q4_K_M is the default. Read the glossary →

item.title: AI data centers' hidden water bill is 12x what you see — we did the math
item.description: New on forum.omc.network: US data centers used 66B liters on site in 2023, but ~800B generating their power — a 12x multiplier that rewrites the closed-loop cooling debate. The full breakdown, with sources. Read →

item.title: We caught our own bug: the 'burn' that wasn't actually burning — and fixed it on-chain
item.description: Our review found two 'burn' paths only moved tokens to a dead address, so totalSupply() never dropped — a weak mechanism doing the wrong job. Slashing and the settlement fee now call burn() on the token, redeployed in a cascade. On-chain proof: one 6.0 tOMC slash cut supply by exactly 1.2 (its 20% burn share). New addresses in the footer. Read →

item.title: OMC now spans three sites — and one of them ranks AI tools with zero affiliate links
item.description: The ecosystem now covers omc.network, top.omc.network (independent, no-affiliate AI tool rankings) and forum.omc.network — the Decentralized Compute Forum with deep essays and open comments. All three cross-link. Explore →

item.title: Jensen Huang says data centers are becoming 'AI factories' — we're building the marketplace for that intelligence
item.description: At GTC 2024, NVIDIA's CEO described the shift from file-cabinet data centers to AI factories that manufacture intelligence at scale — with compute and power, not chips, as the binding constraint. That's the exact problem OMC's decentralized GPU marketplace is built to solve. Analysis → (industry commentary, not investment advice)

item.title: Vitalik says decentralized compute belongs in the d/acc toolbox — so we built it
item.description: In 'd/acc' (Nov 2024), Ethereum's founder argues open, verifiable, decentralized computing is a defensive technology worth building — including markets that route idle GPUs to real workloads. OMC is our answer to that call. Analysis → (industry commentary, not investment advice)

item.title: Cloud GPU pricing is a black box. We opened it — H100 spreads, spot arbitrage, methodology included
item.description: New on forum.omc.network: a Pricing Watch series on the real cost of a training run, H100 rate spreads between hyperscalers and decentralized marketplaces, and reserved-vs-spot arbitrage. No sponsors, no affiliate links — the methodology ships with every piece. Read →

item.title: Altman: the cost of intelligence trends toward the cost of energy. Here's why that's our whole thesis
item.description: In 'The Intelligence Age' (Sep 2024), OpenAI's CEO argues intelligence becomes a utility as its cost falls toward the price of energy — making compute supply and power access the hard constraints. OMC is built for exactly that world. Analysis → (industry commentary, not investment advice)
